Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Successfully rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The service is now healthy (error rate 0.002) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried and confirmed it was created.)

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release.
